```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("flight_data_2024.csv") |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No passengers match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```


# Page 1

## {.sidebar}

With the holiday season approaching, airline delays are a major worry amongst travelers in the US. This dashboard analyzes flight delays, cancellations, and on-time performance across major US airports in 2024.

Use the filters below to explore different aspects of airline performance.

Learn more about the dataset and download it: [flight_data_2024.csv](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/hrishitpatil/flight-data-2024)
